overview.text: Russian cruise missiles landing in Poland have NATO's Rutte reassuring eastern members, amid reports Moscow plans a nuclear-armed satellite.
Iran vows to end the U.S. naval blockade by all available means, while Trump says Iranian attacks have done no damage.
Malaysia plans to return thousands of Rohingya to Myanmar days after the ICJ ruled Myanmar committed genocide, and the UK sanctioned Myanmar's military leaders.
Ousted Bangladeshi leader Sheikh Hasina says she will return from exile in India on December 16.
The Pentagon sharply rebuked Canada over defense spending and its review of F-35 purchases.
CrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler in a $44 billion cybersecurity deal.

stories.headline: ✅ Spurs 123, Kings 107
stories.summary: Final · at Kings · Record 15-3

stories.headline: Sheikh Hasina says she will return to Bangladesh December 16
stories.summary: A spokesperson says the ousted Bangladeshi prime minister plans to return home from exile in India on Dec. 16.
stories.why: Her return could reshape Bangladesh's politics.

stories.headline: Pentagon rebukes Canada over defense spending and F-35 review
stories.summary: The Pentagon accused Canada of falling short as a credible partner in defending North America. It criticized Canadian military spending and Ottawa's reconsideration of American-made F-35 fighter jets.
stories.why: It strains a key alliance on continental defense.

stories.headline: Judge ruled Omar could assert congressional privacy protections during home search
stories.summary: Records show a magistrate judge who authorized the federal search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's home ruled she was entitled to assert protections afforded to sitting members of Congress at the search's outset.

stories.headline: Iran vows to end U.S. naval blockade by all means
stories.summary: Iran says it will force the U.S. to lift its blockade. Trump acknowledges increasing Iranian attacks but says they have done no damage.
stories.why: Escalation at sea risks wider conflict and energy disruption.

stories.headline: FBI's No. 2 official reportedly retiring before year's end
stories.summary: Christopher Raia, a veteran agent, is said to be leaving a few months after another deputy departed the FBI.
stories.why: Leadership turnover at the bureau continues.

stories.headline: China-aligned fake personas target Taiwan's election, researchers say
stories.summary: A Vanderbilt tool is detecting AI-generated social media posts that support Chinese Communist Party policies and are aimed at Taiwan's election.
stories.why: Shows AI-driven influence efforts targeting democratic elections.

stories.headline: Russian missiles land in Poland; NATO chief reassures allies
stories.summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is seeking to reassure eastern members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday. Russian incursions into NATO territory are increasing.
stories.why: Direct spillover from the Ukraine war tests NATO.

stories.headline: Malaysia to return thousands of Rohingya refugees to Myanmar
stories.summary: The announcement comes five days after the ICJ ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority.
stories.why: Raises safety concerns for refugees being sent back.

stories.headline: UK sanctions Myanmar military leaders after genocide ruling
stories.summary: Britain sanctioned top Myanmar military leaders after the U.N. court's decision, which sets an international law precedent with implications for the case over Israel's actions in Gaza.

stories.headline: States sue SpaceX over Grok generating child sex images
stories.summary: State attorneys general say Grok is still producing child sexual abuse material and revenge porn. X says every Grok output is screened.
stories.why: Tests legal accountability for AI image tools.

stories.headline: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang
stories.summary: Days after resigning while mired in scandal of extra-marital affairs, Nvidia's Jensen Huang is making a remarkable return.

stories.headline: Elon Musk Faces an A.I. Dilemma at SpaceX
stories.summary: Mr. Musk’s SpaceX is renting out computing power from its data centers to competitors, including Anthropic. That’s making it harder for his own A.I. effort.

stories.headline: Measles a growing risk for adults, experts say
stories.summary: The danger is greatest for the unvaccinated, but vaccinated people born before 1989 may no longer be sufficiently protected, medical experts said.
stories.why: Some adults may want to check their vaccination status.

stories.headline: CVS breakup hasn't quieted antitrust critics
stories.summary: Lawmakers warn that spinning off CVS Health's drugstores will not end scrutiny over the conglomerate's power.
stories.why: Affects health care competition and costs.

stories.headline: H.I.V. Research Networks May Again Seek Federal Funding, With a Twist
stories.summary: The Trump administration restarted the process for funding four large research networks after postponing it earlier this year.

stories.headline: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $44 billion deal
stories.summary: The two major cybersecurity firms will combine as worries grow about hacks fueled by advances in artificial intelligence.
stories.why: Signals consolidation as AI raises cyber risks for companies and governments.

stories.headline: They attended Trump's controversial meme coin dinner. It didn't go well
stories.summary: Trump held another meme coin dinner for top holders of his cryptocurrency — an event that has raised intense controversy. Here's an inside account from two guests who attended.

stories.headline: Britain's landlords are getting bigger. A two-tier rental market may follow
stories.summary: Increasing numbers of corporate landlords could usher in big changes for renters

stories.headline: SEC schedules vote on possible LSU expulsion
stories.summary: LSU's standoff with the SEC over the RJ Luis dispute has escalated into a legal and political fight, with major penalties still possible.

stories.headline: Florida State hires Georgia's Glenn Schumann as head coach
stories.summary: After a three-week search, Florida State tapped Georgia defensive coordinator Glenn Schumann to replace Mike Norvell.

stories.headline: Is Hamilton and Leclerc's Ferrari partnership sustainable? F1 Q&A
stories.summary: BBC F1 correspondent Andrew Benson answers your latest questions after the Las Vegas Grand Prix.

stories.headline: First Children's Booker prize reveals shortlist - and its child judges
stories.summary: The eight books in contention include War by Artemis Fowl author Eoin Colfer and Andrew Donkin.

stories.headline: Jefferson Airplane's Jorma Kaukonen says guitar has always been a 'great refuge'
stories.summary: Kaukonen helped define the sound of the '60s as the lead guitar player and a founding member of Jefferson Airplane. Now 85, he's still touring with his band Hot Tuna.

stories.headline: A First for a ‘Curious Incident’ Production: A Cast of Neurodivergent Actors
stories.summary: A company for neurodivergent actors steps up to a bigger stage with its full-spectrum model of inclusion.
